pattern_hunter.finding: Two pre-freeze reviews independently identified the same strategy-fairness defect in 30 cases. The cases were repaired before holdout freeze, all commitments were regenerated, stale receipts were rejected, and two fresh complete reviews passed the repaired 60-case set.

gonzo.claim: The public corpus and frozen authority can be reproduced without private-data disclosure or moving source references.
gonzo.evidence: All 24 public cases regenerated byte-identically, every source snapshot resolves through the canonical GitHub remote and immutable commit debffb5b9c07d4acdfeaa708c0fbd67358e97632, and public inventory verification found no non-public content.

stress_tests: source content rebind is rejected even after recomputing the inline content hash
underspecified cases without clarification-oracle commitments are rejected
single-strategy grading is rejected when strategy flexibility is declared
transitive schema mutation is rejected after policy freeze

integrator.canonical_truth: evals/manifests/policy-freeze.json bound to evals/manifests/holdout-manifest.json and all referenced schemas/policies
checked: only ID, salted content commitment, split, and stratum for non-public cases
two independent private and two independent public fairness receipts
raw public-case and private-bundle commitment binding
full native repository suite and native Windows source-fixture CI

senior_gate.security_privacy: pass: sealed content, labels, nonces, and detailed reasons remain outside git; public verification uses salted commitments and a private blind verifier
senior_gate.elegance_effectiveness: pass: one public holdout manifest and one policy-freeze artifact; private validation remains external and hash-bound rather than becoming a second public authority
senior_gate.overengineering: pass: each added layer closes a demonstrated failure class—source drift, receipt substitution, strategy bias, private leakage, or post-freeze mutation
senior_gate.principal_review: pass: candidate implementation has not started; corpus, thresholds, endpoint rule, outcomes, fairness receipts, and transitive schemas are frozen first
